_comment: Featured/curated Overton terms that bypass the podcast mention pipeline. These are pinned at the top of the Overton Window with a 'Debated' badge. Pipeline exports cannot overwrite this file.

featured.thesis: When Treasury triples the long-end liquidity buyback the same week it sells 10s and 30s, and the 10y still clears at a multi-year high yield with strong cover, the regime is confessing that private sponsorship of duration is not enough without a standing state bid — and the market is already pricing that bid as too small. Money is in who warehouses duration (banks/pensions/HTM-SLR/dealer inventory) and the issuer as standing long-end bid while coupon supply continues — not debt scare, not Nvidia.
featured.who_collects_rent: Whoever sets captivity / balance-sheet rules and runs the buyback backstop — regulators / Treasury / Fed plumbing — not the coupon; dealers take warehouse/fees; equity of stuffed franchises can be leftover.
featured.decisive_test: (1) Sep 9 10y STAMPED — BTC 2.71, high yield 4.834%, indirects ~79% → private bid intact at high levels; buyback expansion leans cosmetic (WATCH; one auction ≠ RELEGATE). (2) Sep 10 30y STAMPED — private bid intact / cosmetic lean (see falsifier_log). (3) Sep 10 first enlarged long-end buyback STAMPED — max $6bn; accepted $5.187bn (~86% of max) from $10.49bn offered (23/40 issues) → thick take-up / backstop used into strong auction sponsorship; still WATCH (not alone RELEGATE). (4) Nov 4 QRA — buyback maxes cut or framed temporary → structural state-bid claim fails → RELEGATE.
featured.nested_note: Sep 9 stamp: 10y ~$39bn · high 4.834% · BTC 2.71 · indirects ~79% (TreasuryDirect R_20260909_2). Sep 10 stamp: 30y ~$22bn PASS + long-end buyback op take-up $5.187bn/$6bn max (~86%); 23/40 issues accepted from $10.49bn offered (BBR_20260910174000). Next check: Nov 4 QRA buyback maxes. Anti-Overton: SV room on AGI/racks/hyperscaler capex/power souvenirs vs empty space = fiscal-repression plumbing (who warehouses duration; buybacks as confession). Nest power/interconnect under Trap #1 / AI foundation — NOT this card's headline. Calendar: Sep 15 20y; CPI Sep 11; FOMC+SEP Sep 15–16; Nov 4 refunding.
